column1: # The operations a size-built function may call a runtime routine for (compiler-rt, -Os, 68020 and later).
# candidate KEY ROUTINE INLINE_BYTES CALL_BYTES: one site as an inline expansion and as a call, the whole function (`rts` included); tests/size_libcalls.rs fails when the compiler disagrees.
# member ROUTINE BYTES [NEEDS,...]: the routine as linked (ld map, 2026-11-09) and the routines it calls.
